name: Variance Occlusion Maps
definition: A technique to approximate the Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of voxel values in a spherical region using only the first two moments (mean and variance) to determine the percentage of occluding voxels for ambient occlusion and soft shadows.
summary: Variance Occlusion Maps approximate volumetric occlusion using statistical moments to generate soft shadows and ambient occlusion directly from 3D data, unlike 2D depth-based methods.
